instruction: Fix `hex_encode` so it encodes the string's UTF-8 bytes (the current code calls `.hex()` directly on the str, which has no such method).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec.py b/codec.py
--- a/codec.py
+++ b/codec.py
@@ -17,7 +17,7 @@
 
 def hex_encode(data):
     """Hex-encode a string."""
-    return data.hex()
+    return data.encode("utf-8").hex()
